articles.summary: Third Quarter 2026 Highlights Record diluted earnings per share (“EPS”) of $2.21 with net income of $36.4 million and a 1.52% return on average assets (“ROAA”) Expanded net interest margin (“NIM”) on a tax-equivalent yield (“TEY”) basis 1 3 basis points to 3.58% Strong capital markets revenue of $16.9 million, up 10% on a linked-quarter basis Solid wealth management revenue of $5.7 million, up 12% year-over-year Robust loan growth of 11% annualized on a linked-quarter basis, excluding m2 Equipment Finance (“m2”) portfolio runoff Excellent asset quality with nonperforming assets (“NPAs”) improving to 0.39% of total assets, the lowest level in two years Opportunistic share repurchases of $9.5 million, or 94,861 shares of common stock, during the quarter MOLINE, Ill., Oct. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - QCR Holdings, Inc.
